app.title: AI editor for DOCX/DOC/PDF via Markdown
app.intro_description: Upload a DOCX, legacy DOC, or PDF. When needed, the app auto-converts the source to DOCX, assembles meaningful blocks from several paragraphs, adds neighboring context for the model, and builds a new DOCX.
app.pdf_caption: PDF is imported by converting it to DOCX; structure and formatting quality depend on the source PDF and the converter.
app.file_too_large: The DOCX/DOC/PDF size exceeds the allowed limit of {limit} MB. Please upload a smaller file.
app.preparation_state_unavailable: The saved file preparation state was lost or is unavailable. If the document did not appear in ready mode, upload the file again to restart preparation.
app.preparation_discards_result_warning: The new setting requires analyzing the document again, and the finished result of the previous run will be deleted with no way to restore it. Download the files below if you still need them, or restore the previous setting.
app.preparation_discards_result_confirm: Delete the finished result and analyze the document again
app.result_unavailable: The processing result is unavailable in the current session.
app.restartable_generic_info: You can change the settings and start processing again without re-uploading the file.
app.single_block_info: The document fits into a single block. For long files, processing runs block by block with neighboring context.
app.activity_document_parsed: The document was parsed into {count} blocks.
app.restartable_stopped_notice: Processing of the file «{filename}» was stopped. You can change the settings and start again without re-uploading.
app.restartable_failed_notice: Processing of the file «{filename}» failed. You can change the settings and start again without re-uploading.
recommend.notice_generic: Settings for this document were selected automatically.
recommend.notice_with_changes: Settings for this document were selected automatically: {changes}.
flow.no_jobs_built: Failed to assemble any block for processing.
flow.empty_target_block: An empty target block was detected before sending to the model.
flow.quality_gate_blocked: Preparation blocked by the quality gate: the document requires structural repair before processing.
flow.quality_gate_blocked_with_reasons: Preparation blocked by the quality gate: the document requires structural repair before processing. Reasons: {reasons}
flow.quality_gate_warning: Processing continued in best-effort mode: the document structure was recognized with elevated risk.
flow.quality_gate_warning_with_reasons: Processing continued in best-effort mode: the document structure was recognized with elevated risk. Reasons: {reasons}
sidebar.text_operation_help: Literary editing improves text that is already in the selected language. Use Translation for text that is not yet in the target language. If the text is already translated, literary editing is usually the better choice.
sidebar.source_language_help: Use 'Auto' only as a best-effort mode. For already-translated text, literary editing is usually the better choice.
sidebar.same_language_warning: The source and target language are the same. If you only need a stylistic upgrade, literary editing is usually the better choice.
sidebar.audiobook_postprocess_label: Additionally: prepare ElevenLabs narration (main result unchanged)
sidebar.audiobook_postprocess_help: Prepares a separate narration text for ElevenLabs without changing the main DOCX/Markdown result.
sidebar.custom_model_help: You can specify a provider-qualified selector, e.g. openrouter:google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview.
sidebar.image_mode_audiobook_caption: In audiobook mode, images are always left unchanged.
sidebar.keep_variants_help: Keeps all generated image variants for later comparison.
sidebar.editorial_intensity_help: Careful: fix only clear awkwardness and calques, keeping the author's wording and sentence structure. Literary: freely rebuild phrasing and rhythm so the result reads like native prose, while keeping the meaning.
image.desc_no_change: Leaves all images as they are, without any processing.
image.desc_safe: Slightly improves the source image without a semantic redraw.
image.desc_semantic_direct: Performs a creative redraw via vision + generate. Better for infographics, composition, color, and complex layouts.
image.desc_semantic_structured: Performs a content-conservative redraw in an office presentation style. Better for diagrams, tables, and structural images.
image.desc_compare_all: Builds safe, creative, and structural variants at once so you can pick the best before the final DOCX.
result.blocked_delivery_notice: Result blocked by the final quality gate. Downloads below are diagnostic only.
result.partial_available_warning: An intermediate Markdown result from the last run is available.
result.notice_review: Done. {count} paragraph(s) worth checking for formatting — see the review file.
result.notice_fix: Done. {count} heading(s)/list(s) became plain text — a manual fix is needed. See the review file.
result.notice_defect: Warning: {count} paragraph(s) may have taken on the wrong formatting. See the review file.
result.review_accepted_note: The result is accepted — the listed items are advisory; the document is ready to use.
result.cleanup_advisory_failed: Reader cleanup could not be applied; the original translated document was preserved.
result.cleanup_aborted_failed_chunk_rati: Reader cleanup was aborted: {failed_chunk_count} of {cleanup_chunk_count} chunks failed ({failed_chunk_ratio_pct}%), above the allowed {max_failed_chunk_ratio_pct}%. No cleanup was applied — the translated document was preserved unchanged.
result.cleanup_discarded_image_anchor_lo: Reader cleanup was discarded: {missing_image_id_count} image anchor(s) would have been lost and the operation responsible could not be identified. All {discarded_cleanup_operation_count} accepted operation(s) were dropped — the translated document was preserved with every image in place.
result.cleanup_anchor_repair_rolled_back: The image-anchor repair pass was rolled back: it would have lost {missing_image_id_count} image anchor(s), so its {discarded_cleanup_operation_count} operation(s) were dropped. The rest of the cleanup was delivered with every image in place.
result.narration_omitted: Narration was omitted because the final cleaned text could not be mapped safely to narration boundaries.
result.narration_failed: Narration preparation failed; the document result remains available.
result.narration_review_data: The narration text is ready. {count} passage(s) look like reference markers ({rules}) — worth checking before sending them to ElevenLabs.
result.narration_source_fallback_exclude: {count} block(s) ({chars} characters) were left out of the narration text: the model returned no accepted output for them, so the source text stands in the DOCX and would have been read aloud untranslated.
result.narration_omitted_paragraphs_excl: {count} paragraph(s) ({chars} characters) were left out of the narration text: the model returned nothing for them, so the source text stands in the DOCX and would have been read aloud untranslated.
result.primary_artifacts_not_saved: The result is available in this session, but its files could not be saved to disk.
preview.markdown_help: Only one Markdown block is shown on screen to keep the interface responsive for large documents.
preview.normalization: Paragraph normalization: raw {raw} -> logical {logical} | merges: {groups} groups, {merged} paragraphs
status.size_meta: Size: {size} MB | Paragraphs: {paragraphs} | Images: {images} | Characters: {chars} | Blocks: {blocks}
status.conversion_reused: Conversion: reusing the already converted DOCX copy; re-import is skipped.
